data.name: Embrace The Potato
data.detailed_description:
Embrace the Potato is a nothing simulator with a trap built into the wait. A potato floats in deep space. It looks fine at first. Time does not care.

Every PC player knows the rule. You get a short window to decide if a purchase was a mistake. Embrace the Potato leans into that window on purpose. A grandfather clock ticks while dark ambient fills the void. The potato slowly darkens, shrivels, and grows mold as the clock runs toward one hundred twenty one minutes.

In the corner sits [ ABORT AND REFUND ]. It looks like an exit. It is part of the joke. This is not a skill game. It is a patience game about whether you leave early or sit through the whole collapse. Make it far enough and refund eligibility turns hostile. Finish the wait and the potato reaches its end state. From there you can reverse the decay and restore the potato. Restoration is possible. Easy escape is not the point.

You can tumble the potato freely while nothing else demands your attention. Local save keeps your progress if you close the game and come back later.

Key features:

A single potato in a cosmic void as the entire game.

Real time decay across a long AFK session, including skin change, shriveling, and mold.

360 degree tumble controls against a deep space starfield.

Oppressive audio with ambient pressure and a relentless tick.

A hostile refund and abort joke that escalates as you approach the point of no return.

Timed “Embrace the Potato” voice cues. Click the potato within ten seconds to earn the timed achievements.

Achievements for the major wait milestones, full decomposition, and a complete reversal back to the potato’s original form.

Embrace the Potato is for players who want to buy the bit, feel the clock, and live with what the wait costs.

data.short_description: An AFK idle trap where you tumble a rotting potato in deep space, endure the ticking clock, and choose whether to abort for a refund or wait out the full collapse for what comes after.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any GPU with WebGL2 support
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows-compatible sound device
  • Additional Notes: Simple AFK experience. Integrated graphics supported; large textures/video may cause hitching on very low-end hardware.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad-core 2.5 GHz or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with 2 GB+ VRAM (or strong modern integrated graphics)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows-compatible sound device
  • Additional Notes: Recommended for smoother tumbling, morph scrubbing, and video-texture playback.
